answer_result.answer: Yes. Calvin explicitly said his plan for now is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase, and later said that after his tour he is off to explore and grow his brand. He also attended a networking event to meet more artists who he said would help him build up his fan base.

question.question: Does Calvin want to expand his brand?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Aww, that's cool, Dave. Reminiscing is always fun! That pic you shared takes me back to my trip to the Ferrari dealership. I saw a lot of amazing cars, but as for me, my car is the best and  I'm pretty proud of this. Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me. Take a look at this beauty!
[Image caption: a photography of a red car is lifted on a lift in a garage]
[S12T7] (dia_id: D12:7)

Dave: Your car looks great, Calvin! I can tell why you're proud. Having something like that is motivating. It's like a reminder of what you can achieve.
[S12T8] (dia_id: D12:8)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Seeing it everyday keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing.
[S12T9] (dia_id: D12:9)

Dave: Sounds like you're really motivated, Calvin. What's the biggest goal you're working towards, music-wise or something else?
[S12T10] (dia_id: D12:10)

Calvin: My plan for now is to expand my brand worldwide and grow my fanbase. I want my music to reach more people and make an impact. Working with artists from around the globe and challenging myself to create special music are goals of mine too. Look at the photo of how I performed with the boys last night, they are great at the music!
[Image caption: a photo of a band playing on stage with lights on]
[S12T11] (dia_id: D12:11)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! Working with different artists and crafting great sounds will definitely help you reach your goals. Keep it up and keep making a difference!
[S12T12] (dia_id: D12:12)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I'm determined to make my dreams come true.
[S12T13] (dia_id: D12:13)

Dave: Glad to help, Calvin! Eager to see what you do. Keep at it and never forget your dreams!
[S12T14] (dia_id: D12:14)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I appreciate your support, it means a lot to me. I'll keep going for my dreams.
[S12T15] (dia_id: D12:15)

Dave: No problem, Calvin! Just remember to stay focused and keep going. You've got this!
[S12T16] (dia_id: D12:16)

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-07-21, said he started making music to follow his dreams and is "stoked" about how far he's come [S11T10].
- On 2023-07-21, when Dave asked how he deals with the pressure and stays motivated: collaborating with others and learning from them keeps him motivated, and surrounding himself with positive energy and passion helps as well [S11T10].
- On 2023-08-03, said his plan for now (when Dave asked for his biggest goal) is to expand his brand worldwide and grow his fanbase — "I want my music to reach more people and make an impact" — and working with artists from around the globe and challenging himself to create special music are goals of his too (an extension of his earlier world-tour dream, see above) [S12T11].

- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. - On 2023-10-25, shared a photo of himself performing at a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table in a nightclub) with someone he admires — "So amazing!" (Dave: "You looked super comfortable on stage. Calvin: performing "with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (complements his long-stated "fuels my soul"/concerts-are-what-he-lives-for remarks above; closing exchange details in the 2023-10-25 entry of ## Relationships) [S26T9].
- On 2023-10-29, told Dave that since they last talked he went to a networking event to meet more artists — "so cool!" — and that the people he met will help him build up his fan base — "super excited about what it could lead to." (an active step in his plan to expand his brand and grow his fanbase — see the 2023-08-03 entry above; Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T1].
- On 2023-10-29, when Dave asked for music updates ("How's everything with the music? Any updates?"): Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently ("I've had some great collaborations recently") and his album is almost finished ("my album is almost finished") — a follow-up to the album that dropped 2023-09-11 (see above) — and promised he'll send Dave some previews soon ("I'll send you some previews soon"; Dave: "Cool, Calvin! (the 2023-10-29 update above had his album at "almost finished") — and shared photos of the party: a group of people sitting in a room with a projector screen ("Take a look at the photo of the party in the mansion, it was so energizing!"), a group of people dancing at the party, and a group of people standing on top of a stage [S28T1][S28T3][S28T5].

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely take you up on that offer. It would be fun to check out your garage and maybe even get some ideas for future projects. I'll let you know when I'm in Boston. Keep pursuing your passions and keep those cars rolling. You rock!

Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Appreciate the kind words and support. Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music! Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!

- On 2023-09-13, said it's been a lot: it's "kinda overwhelming to think so many appreciate it", but it's cool that it's connecting with people, and it really motivates him to make even better music; moments like this remind him why he got into music — making a difference and sharing his own story — and the positive feedback gives him strength to keep going and reach more people: "My journey's just getting started!" [S18T3][S18T5].
- On 2023-09-13, said what's next is a tour ("Next up, a tour - so excited!"), and after that he's off to explore and grow his brand — "Can't wait to see what the future has in store!" (Dave asked about cities or venues, but Calvin did not answer in this exchange) [S18T7][S18T8].
- On 2023-09-13, got excited about the upcoming tour: "Yay! Dave! We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!" [S18T9].

I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds." Dave also told him he attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band on stage with bright lights); Calvin: "Rock concerts always have such an electrifying atmosphere!" (Dave's details in the Rock band and Music sections of /memories/dave.md) [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4].

evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- Has been experimenting with different genres lately, pushing himself out of his comfort zone — adding electronic elements to his songs gives them "a fresh vibe"; he calls it "an exciting process of self-discovery and growth" [S11T6].
- Finds switching between styles challenging — "it's a matter of finding the right balance between sticking to [his] sound and trying new stuff"; "it can be intimidating, but that's what makes it so exciting and keeps [him] motivated to keep going!" [S11T8].
- On 2023-11-02, said the connection music creates with people is "that connection I'm aiming for with my music" (his goal for his music; complements his 2023-10-25 "passion and purpose" remark — see ## Music) [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, shared a photo of the studio setup (a recording studio with a monitor, keyboard, and monitor) — Calvin: "Take a loot at my studio setup, that's look awesome, isn't it?"; Dave: "Wow, your studio looks stunning!" [S28T27].
- On 2023-11-02, when Dave asked how he likes hanging out there and whether he watches much TV: he only works in the studio; he has a separate room for relaxation with a TV (photo of a living room with a couch, chair, television and a table — "that room is cozy and relaxing"), which is "a great way to unwind and get inspired" [S28T29].
